catalog.name: Lacuna
catalog.description: A complete visual shell for Omarchy with a custom bar, attached utility sidebar, system controls, expressive widgets, and optional desktop ambience.
catalog.author: OldJobobo
catalog.installNote: After cloning, run cd "$HOME/lacuna" && ./scripts/lacuna to start the guided installer.

catalog.name: SHIBUMI

catalog.author: HANCORE
